planetary_specification.source: Hindu Predictive Astrology by Baggona Panchanga

deeptha.prediction: Gains from conveyances, respect from elders, fame, wealth and good progeny.

swastha.prediction: Fame, wealth, position, lands, happiness and good children.

santha.prediction: Strength and courage, helping relations, comfort and happiness.

peedya.prediction: Prosecution, incarceration, pilfering habits and expulsion from country.

deena.prediction: Jealousy, mental worry, brain trouble, sickness and degradation.

vikala.prediction: Diseases, orphanage, loss of wife and children and disgrace.

khala.prediction: Losses, mean birth, troubles from various sources, quarrels with parents and relations, imprisonment and hating God and sacred literature.

bhita.prediction: Losses from various sources, torture, foes, mean habits and danger in foreign countries.

bhava_lord_placement.in_own_house: Spouse will be devoted, strong, and bring profound stability to the native's life.
bhava_lord_placement.in_kendra_1_4_7_10: Early marriage; spouse brings fortune, public success, and domestic harmony.
bhava_lord_placement.in_trikona_5_9: A highly fortunate and affectionate partnership, often resulting in wealthy and prosperous alliances.
bhava_lord_placement.in_dusthana_6_8_12: Indicates delays in marriage, friction, temporary separations, or health issues for the partner.

planets_occupying_bhava.Jupiter: A virtuous, wealthy, and philosophically inclined partner.
planets_occupying_bhava.Venus: A deeply romantic, passionate, and beautiful partner, though prone to excessive sensuality.
planets_occupying_bhava.Mars: Kuja Dosha. Indicates friction, argumentative nature in the home, or a highly active and assertive partner.
planets_occupying_bhava.Saturn: Delayed marriage. A mature, serious, or older partner. Requires patience but offers long-term loyalty.

bhava_lord_placement.in_kendra_or_trikona: High academic achievements, continuous learning, and acquisition of degrees with honors.
bhava_lord_placement.in_dusthana_6_8_12: Breaks in education, changes in subjects, or struggles to complete formal degrees despite high intelligence.
bhava_lord_placement.associated_with_mercury: Exceptional analytical skills, highly suited for mathematics, engineering, or astrology.

planets_occupying_bhava.Mercury: Brilliant intellect, rapid comprehension, and success in writing or communication.
planets_occupying_bhava.Jupiter: Profound wisdom, success in classical studies, law, or philosophy.
planets_occupying_bhava.Rahu: Unconventional education, success in foreign languages, or highly technical/obscure fields.

bhava_lord_placement.in_own_house: Blessed with good, intelligent, and prosperous children who bring joy.
bhava_lord_placement.in_kendra_1_4_7_10: Children will achieve high status and outshine the parents in success.
bhava_lord_placement.in_dusthana_6_8_12: Delays in childbirth, anxieties regarding children, or distance from progeny.

planets_occupying_bhava.Jupiter: Excellent progeny, highly educated children. (Note: Karako Bhava Nasaya rule may apply if afflicted).
planets_occupying_bhava.Sun: Fewer children, but they will be highly ambitious, authoritative, and successful.
planets_occupying_bhava.Ketu: Obstacles in having children, or spiritual/unconventional paths regarding progeny.

bhava_lord_placement.in_eighth_house: Vipareeta Raja Yoga. Highly protective of life span; grants Purnayu (long life).
bhava_lord_placement.in_kendra_with_benefics: Grants a long, healthy life free from severe chronic illnesses.
bhava_lord_placement.afflicted_by_malefics: Requires careful attention to health; potential for sudden shifts in vitality (Alpayu or Madhyayu indicators).

planets_occupying_bhava.Saturn: Ayush Karaka in Ayur Bhava extends the life span significantly, granting a long life.
planets_occupying_bhava.Mars: Prone to sudden accidents, surgeries, or injuries. Requires caution.
planets_occupying_bhava.Jupiter: A peaceful and natural end of life, often with spiritual awareness.

engine_metadata.purpose: Comprehensive Life Problem Resolution and Predictive Engine

planetary_relationships.explanation: Calculates Mitrutva (Friendship), Shatrutva (Enmity), and Sama (Neutrality) affecting planetary strength.

evaluations.moon_afflicted_by_saturn: Vish Yoga: The native is experiencing deep melancholy, pessimism, or clinical depression. A sense of isolation is prominent.
evaluations.moon_afflicted_by_rahu: Grahan Yoga: The mind is plagued by phobias, severe anxiety, overthinking, and irrational fears.
evaluations.mercury_combust_or_debilitated: Nervous exhaustion, inability to concentrate, and communication breakdowns leading to frustration.

remedies.moon_affliction: Chant 'Om Som Somaya Namah'. Offer milk and water to a Shiva Linga on Mondays. Wear a Pearl in silver.
remedies.rahu_affliction: Donate black sesame seeds. Avoid taking major life decisions during sudden emotional spikes.

evaluations.seventh_lord_in_dusthana: Marriage is delayed due to karmic blockages or inability to find the right match.
evaluations.mars_in_1_4_7_8_12: Kuja Dosha (Manglik). Creates friction and misunderstandings. Best suited to marry another Manglik.
evaluations.saturn_aspecting_seventh: Marriage will happen late (usually after 28-30 years). Requires a mature approach to partnerships.

remedies.kuja_dosha: Perform Kumbha Vivaha or daily recitation of Hanuman Chalisa.
remedies.venus_weak: Respect women, donate white clothes on Fridays, and wear a Diamond or White Sapphire.

evaluations.tenth_lord_in_eighth: Sudden breaks in career, job loss, or constant changes in profession.
evaluations.saturn_afflicted_in_tenth: The native faces immense struggle, lack of recognition, and hostile superiors despite hard work.

remedies.sun_weak: Offer Arghya (water) to the Sun God every morning. Recite the Aditya Hridaya Stotram.
remedies.saturn_issues: Light a mustard oil lamp under a Peepal tree on Saturdays. Serve the underprivileged.

evaluations.fifth_lord_with_rahu: Pitra Dosha. Indicates delays, miscarriages, or extreme worry regarding children.
evaluations.jupiter_debilitated: Karako Bhava Nasaya. The native desires children deeply but faces biological or circumstantial hurdles.

remedies.jupiter_weak: Chant 'Om Brihaspataye Namah'. Donate yellow sweets on Thursdays. Wear a Yellow Sapphire.

ayurdaya_longevity_logic.explanation: To be parsed by the code engine to calculate the threat to lifespan (Maraka).

balarishta.conditions: Moon heavily afflicted by malefics in Kendra, with no Jupiter aspect.

alpayu.conditions: 8th lord debilitated, Ascendant lord weak, malefics in 8th house.

madhyayu.conditions: Mixed influences. Benefics and malefics equally distributed in Kendras and Trikonas.

purnayu.conditions: Saturn strong, 8th lord strong, Jupiter aspecting Ascendant.

critical_periods.rule_1: The native faces extreme physical danger during the Dasha (major period) of the 2nd lord and Bhukti (sub-period) of the 7th lord.
critical_periods.rule_2: If Saturn aspects the Maraka planet, the danger is amplified.

ayurdaya_longevity_logic.remedies_for_health_danger: Perform the Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra daily. Seek immediate medical counsel alongside spiritual practices.

bhava_lords_in_houses.description: Rules for when the ruler of one house is placed in another house.

first_lord_lagnesha.in_house_1: Native is strong, healthy, independent, and likely to be a leader or self-made person.
first_lord_lagnesha.in_house_2: Native is intensely focused on family and wealth accumulation. Will have good speech and financial success.
first_lord_lagnesha.in_house_6: Native will face debts, diseases, or enemies, but if the lord is strong, they will conquer them. Prone to military or medical careers.
first_lord_lagnesha.in_house_10: Native will attain great professional success, fame, and a highly respected position in society.

seventh_lord_kalatranatha.in_house_1: The spouse will be a prominent figure in the native's life; native may marry someone known since childhood.
seventh_lord_kalatranatha.in_house_6: Indicates sickly spouse, divorce, or intense friction in marriage. The spouse may be from a medical or legal background.
seventh_lord_kalatranatha.in_house_12: Spouse may be from a foreign land, or there may be separation. Indicates high expenditure on account of the partner.

planets_in_bhavas.description: Results of specific Grahas occupying specific Houses.

sun.in_house_1: Makes the native ambitious, authoritative, proud, and vital, but can cause thinning hair and a hot temper.
sun.in_house_7: Causes friction in marriage due to ego clashes. The spouse may be proud or dominant. Good for foreign travel.
sun.in_house_10: Highly excellent placement (Digbala). Brings government favor, high administrative positions, success, and fame.

moon.in_house_1: Native is highly imaginative, emotional, moody, and deeply attached to their mother or home.
moon.in_house_4: Excellent for domestic happiness, owning good properties, and possessing a kind, nurturing heart.
moon.in_house_8: Balarishta (danger in childhood). Creates intense emotional turmoil, psychic sensitivity, and potential inheritance issues.

saturn.in_house_7: Delays marriage. The spouse will be mature, older, hardworking, or serious. Unromantic but highly stable.
saturn.in_house_8: Increases longevity (Ayushkaraka in Ayur Bhava). The native lives a long life but may face chronic, slow-moving health issues.

gaja_kesari_yoga.condition: Jupiter in a Kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Moon.
gaja_kesari_yoga.result: The native will be brilliant, wealthy, eloquent, and highly respected in society. They will defeat their enemies.

kuja_dosha.condition: Mars in the 1st, 4th, 7th, 8th, or 12th house from the Ascendant, Moon, or Venus.
kuja_dosha.result: Causes severe friction, arguments, or danger in marriage. Requires mitigation (parihara) or marriage to another Manglik.
